headline: 10 years ago today, Travis Scott dropped “Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight” 🔥🦅 Released o
body:
10 years ago today, Travis Scott dropped “Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight” 🔥🦅

Released on September 2, 2016, the album debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with roughly 88,000 first-week units, earning Travis his first chart-topping album 🙏

From “goosebumps” and “pick up the phone” to “beibs in the trap” and “sdp interlude,” the project gave us an unforgettable era, with appearances from Kendrick Lamar, André 3000, Kid Cudi, The Weeknd, Young Thug, and more.

A decade later, what’s your favorite song on the album? 👀

📸/ Getty Images
